# Enterprise GrowthBook Pricing
Date: 2026-09-30 | Duration: 13.079999923706055m

## Summary
The discussion covered a 30-month commitment for a self-hosted website for a Saudi travel company, with data stored exclusively in Saudi Arabia on GCP. The initial build is expected within four to six months, followed by approximately two years of personalization before client handover. Globant will operate the system for two to six employees, with expected traffic of around one million content views monthly across web and mobile. The solution includes content management, translation, content generation, personalization, and A/B testing. Pricing begins at a $75,000 annual enterprise license plus $25,000 for 50 experiments, or approximately $100,000 annually, excluding hosting; added support may raise annual pricing to between $75,000 and $150,000. The architecture uses Cloud Run, MongoDB, Compute Engine, and BigQuery in Saudi Arabia. James Shannon will provide a pricing and feature deck, while Karim Elemam requested a clear breakdown of base features, add-ons, and AI capabilities. Sources: 00:10, 01:59, 03:26, 04:20, 05:59, 08:01, 11:30.

## Keywords
Saudi data residency, Google Cloud Platform, GrowthBook licensing, personalization project, experiment pricing blocks, BigQuery

## Action Items

**James Shannon**
Send Karim a concise deck or PDF summarizing GrowthBook enterprise features, pricing, and licensing information (11:30)

**Karim Elemam**
Review the directional pricing and architecture requirements provided by James to prepare the RFP response for the Saudi travel company (00:10)
